title: Start a Seed Oil Expeller Business in Pakistan: Real Cost
description:
Mustard and canola seed from Pakistani farms becomes cooking oil in a simple expeller unit. We explain where to set up, how seed becomes oil and cake (khal), what 100 kg of seed gives, the machines and full cost from a Government of Pakistan (SMEDA) study, the team, and the biggest risk.
